Container.Name: Testerfy
Container.Overview:
Testerfy is a Spotify track rating app that lets you like/dislike tracks and automatically manages your library based on your ratings. Perfect for music discovery workflows.
**Requirements:** - Spotify account (Free or Premium) - Spotify Developer App credentials (Client ID & Secret)
**Setup:** 1. Create a Spotify app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard 2. Set redirect URI to: http://[YOUR-UNRAID-IP]:5247/api/auth/callback (HTTPS recommended via Tailscale) 3. Copy your Client ID and Client Secret into the config below 4. Access WebUI and authenticate with Spotify
**Tip:** Use Tailscale to access Testerfy securely from anywhere without exposing ports.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for config and database

Config.Name: Redirect URI
Config.Description: Must match your Spotify app settings. Use your Unraid IP or Tailscale hostname (HTTPS required).

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random string for session security. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
